notes: Third-party validation target: humanize 4.16.0 (MIT, see LICENSE-humanize), vendored unmodified from the PyPI sdist. Only its dependency-free test modules are vendored (test_number, test_filesize, test_lists); test_time/test_i18n need freezegun and test_benchmarks needs pytest-benchmark, so the modules they cover (time.py, i18n.py) are excluded from mutation rather than scored against an absent suite.
